name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler' is the domain; the '_30' suffix is a meaningful domain ID = the per-event dispatch table index 0x30, NOT a Ghidra address residue. Verified: table base 0x51B91, this entry at 0x51C51, (0x51C51-0x51B91)/4 = 48 = 0x30; first dword at 0x51C51 = c6 51 03 00 = 0x000351C6 (this function). The '__ch21_ai_ctrl' descriptor accurately reflects behavior: chapter 21 turn-event handler that arms AI control flags. Cross-checked against fd2-knowledge chapter 21 (亞述森林, multi-wave enemy formation with mid-battle reinforcement/AI changes).
purpose: Chapter 21 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x30, fires at turn-event slot 1 / turn 5 phase 0): arm AI control flag value 3 for two NPC char ranges.
logic_summary: Calls fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range twice: range 0x23..0x2A (8 chars) with flag 3, then range 0x43..0x4A (8 chars) with flag 3 (16 chars total). The setter writes the low 4 bits of runtime_char_array[i].pCombat_aux_block[0xD] for each char in the inclusive range, which encodes a per-event AI/dialog control flag. The event_arg is unused. In the binary the second call shares a borrowed Class-3 tail: after pushing its 3 args (0x43,0x4A,3) the handler does JMP 0x34F39, falling into the CALL fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range; ADD ESP,0xC; RET tail of fd2_chapter_event_handler_12__ch15_dialog_with_state @ 0x34F02 -- a size optimisation; functionally exact source = two plain calls.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatch-table event argument (1-arg cdecl ABI of the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91). This handler does not read it ((void)event_arg).
params.reason: Descriptive, matches the dispatch-table ABI parameter and the established convention used across the chapter_event_handler family in this file; no address residue.

comment_original_issue: Source comment block (lines 55-71) was accurate and precise but contained one non-ASCII em-dash on line 64 ('NPC char ranges --') violating the src ASCII-only rule.
notes: reads_globals/writes_globals empty because this handler touches no global directly; all combat_aux_block effects flow through the callee fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range (which writes data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[*].pCombat_aux_block[0xD]). Callees verified: 0x3419C = fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range, 0x34F39 = borrowed tail inside fd2_chapter_event_handler_12__ch15_dialog_with_state (0x34F02-0x34F41), 0x36CD7 = __CHK. Only xref to this function is the data dispatch-table entry at 0x51C51. char range values 0x23-0x2A and 0x43-0x4A are runtime_char_array slot indices for this battle's formation (not item/spell/job IDs). Commit included src/field/chevt2.c + this shard only; two unrelated pre-staged shards (00023cd5.json, 00023e39.json) were deliberately left out of this commit via explicit pathspec.
